data.long_meaning: The name Gayleen is derived from the Greek word 'gaios' meaning joyful and 'leos' meaning hidden. In ancient Greece, this name was given to a child who was believed to bring joy and happiness to those around them, while also being hidden or protected from harm. The name Gayleen carries the meaning “Joyful hidden one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
